officialJapaneseCatalog.title: 2026-2027 GRAY SNOWBOARDS PERFECT GUIDE (Japanese)
officialJapaneseCatalog.evidence: Official 26/27 catalog confirms nine sizes I, IIn, II, IIw, III, IIIw, IVw, IV and Vw; full geometry and stance table; model position as a premium hammerhead; price JPY 140,000 before tax / JPY 154,000 tax-inclusive. The size table labels most sizes Single Camber and IIw as Vario Camber.

officialEnglishCatalog.title: 2026-2027 GRAY SNOWBOARDS PERFECT GUIDE (English)
officialEnglishCatalog.evidence: Season-specific product copy identifies IZANAS beneath the core, polyamide topsheet and upper-edge Titanal ribbon. Construction diagram labels Woodcore, IZANAS, fiberglass, Titanal plate/ribbon and running base.

officialProductPage.evidence: Confirms the 26/27 product listing and model identity.

officialSeasonTechnology.evidence: Confirms the current 26/27 technology context; used as construction cross-check, not as a substitute for the season catalog size table.

seedNormalization.note: Currency normalization only; not an observed China-market price.

units.overallLengthMm: Catalog millimeters; converted to centimeters for representative product length.
units.effectiveEdgeMm: Catalog effective edge length in millimeters.
units.contactLengthMm: Catalog contact length kept separate from effective edge.
units.sidecutRadiusMm: Three printed values preserved in source order; YAML retains exact sequence and expresses them in meters.
units.stanceSetbackMm: Catalog magnitude in millimeters; direction/sign convention is not explained, so preserved as printed.
units.camberMm: Catalog height value in millimeters; profile names are model-size-specific.

scoringReview.decision: Keep existing editorial scores unchanged. The official season catalog supports premium hammerhead/carving intent and describes material construction, but no independent same-season ride test was located. All six scores remain low-confidence estimates; value is especially uncertain because CNY 6537 is a converted Japanese MSRP, not a verified China-market price.
scoringReview.confidence: low; no independently disclosed 26/27 sample test found

unverified: No board weight, China-market retail price, warranty, or explicit reuse permission for product images was found.
No explicit size-specific flex/test observations; manufacturer N/W/T stiffness numerals were not copied into site flex because OCR did not reliably preserve all three columns.

The Type-R official 26/27 technology materials must not be reused as this model's full construction; this [iz] model has its distinct under-core IZANAS, polyamide top and upper-edge Titanal ribbon configuration.
mappingNotes: Nine lengths have a central representative size: III 157. Its dimensions are stored at product level, with all nine official size rows preserved in specs.sizeSpecs and this raw archive.
Official catalog specifically marks IIw as Vario Camber; other size entries are Single Camber. Product-level profile text records this size exception.

The IIIw width value in the existing YAML was 256 mm; official 26/27 Japanese and English tables list 246 mm. Corrected to 246 mm. Other existing size-row geometry was checked against the season-specific catalog and retained.
The catalog's stance setback sign/direction is not explained; YAML and raw data preserve the printed magnitude only.
Image remains an official reference URL; reuse rights are not confirmed.
imageRights: Official image source is identifiable, but no explicit license for local hosting/republication was verified.
